title: ID0429597-DC/Si-D/BE-[MP / R4 170001816] SCB Offline
description:
Reported issue: Sudeep went on site because the loader had no connection to SCB. He performed a reboot on site after which the loader came back online. This took place on 5/06 around 17:56. Unfortunately, the loader is now back offline. Can any analysis be done? Please also schedule an intervention please.

Dear Peter,
I hope this email finds you well. Following my discussion with the R&D team regarding the charger issue, I'd like to outline the maintenance intervention plan.
Required Equipment:
New PLC (MLFB: 6ES7677-2DB40-0AA0)
New CFast card (pre-flashed with version v6.0.3)
USB stick containing Live Linux
Configuration files (previously shared by Francois)
USB keyboard
Technical Prerequisites:
Please ensure Windows Subsystem for Linux (WSL) is installed on your laptop for CFast card mounting and access
Action Items:
Schedule the intervention
Diagnose the charger issue
Replace the existing PLC system if needed
Document findings for R&D team's investigation of the old CFast card
Please confirm if you have access to all the configuration files. If not, I'll be happy to resend them to you.
